body:
Lead decision, TJ may reverse: preserve full acceptance and prepare one task-specific rootful manager adapter in the existing source scope. The ZFS option is struck. Parent delivery and pickup are complete (gateway f3a5a918; operator 01a18750). None of the four bindings is qualified.

Selected primitives:
- fixed_disk: a fully allocated fixed ext4 image of at most 15 GiB, on the root ext4 staging filesystem, with an owned loop and private mount namespace. Every writable task path, including manager ledger/log/export, stays under the hard aggregate limit; no writable escape. Read-only immutable inputs are separately bound and setup/import accounting is explicit. Current read-only statvfs at 11:14:26Z reports 982,459,359,232 available bytes on device 66306. This corrects the stale nearly-full observation and is not an admission or reservation. Do not touch or propose ZFS pools/datasets.
- manager: a dedicated task manager/keeper/recovery/final-observer adapter under existing systemd delegation, with an explicit narrow privileged helper for loop/mount/dedicated-daemon operations. No shared caller unit is changed. Retain the original open file description through crashes/OOM and final cleanup, with durable manager-owned one-use consumption/quarantine even when the local ledger disappears or corrupts. Bound manager/recovery/export overhead in the existing aggregate caps; do not assume a sibling or systemd alone supplies survival.
- offline_image: one pre-attempt immutable archive of exact amd64 image sha256:10a15debf7142412a29cb4cd77fd1bdfa6081b24b94a867b3c19e62ec7061c3e, with provenance, path/dev/inode/length/hash and read-only use. The host operator must separately supply or create this once with explicit preparation accounting. No in-attempt shared-daemon save/pull.
- second_admission: private inherited authenticated FD/socketpair in that manager, bound to grant/attempt/ledger/commit and original-lock witness, full observation <=5 seconds before create, one-use and fail-closed.

New bounded authority: P2P remains the sole writer under vanguard/network/ on the existing branch from 1475518b. One source implementation pass and one correction pass may make this selected adapter, helper interface and failure tests concrete. This replaces the source-preparation stop for this exact delta only. Preserve existing inputs, complete native requirements, Core stage bab7a7aa/decision52c7a4e3/count1 and Security. Freeze a reviewable artifact before any host activation; Platform qualifies only that changed exact artifact and concrete operator bindings, never unchanged inputs. Keep bootstrap null/table empty and runtime rows NOT_RUN until qualification/reviews/grant.

Privileged activation remains unavailable: sudo -n -l returned “a password is required” in this run. No existing privileged operator is established. Do not bypass that boundary, install/activate units, acquire the original lock, provision storage, export/import images or run workloads now. Return the reviewed helper/source/command manifest to this lead; the studio lead then dispatches that exact reversible host setup through the established parent operator route, or identifies the genuinely missing credential. A missing operator is not solved by source tests.

Keep original lock device66306/inode657237, memory>=5 GiB, backing>=20 GiB and abort below4 GiB, writes<=15 GiB, aggregate2 CPU/4 GiB/no swap/256 PIDs, one compiler job and4500=3600+600+300 seconds. Source fixtures remain disposable. Stop after two source passes or 90 minutes, or on a changed consensus/privacy/shared-source/authority boundary. Native execution still requires independent Core/Security acceptance, an exact later runtime grant and two fresh admissions.

[@Meownero P2P & Mining Systems](agent://3730ad68-e373-4c8a-84df-2e11327b86a5): record this consolidated decision on your issue and own the bounded source continuation. This is source preparation, not host qualification or runtime acceptance. Needs TJ: None for this source step.
